3020-4 78850 FIRSTAMENDMENT TO ZONINGLOTDECLARATIONAGREEMENT /'s "Amendment" is made as of this _ day of June, 2016 by HP LAFAYETTE-BOYNTON HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND COMPANY, INC., as nominee (the “HDFC"), a New York not-for-profit corporation established pursuant to Article XI of the New York State Private Housing Finance Law,having an office at 242 West 36th Street, 3rd Floor, New York, New York 10018 and LAFAYETTE-BOYNTON APARTMENT CORPORATION ("LBAC"and together with HDFC, the “Declarant'"), a corporation organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York, having an office at 118-35 Queens Boulevard, Forest Hills, NY 11375. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, HDFC is the fee owner of the parcel of real estate and the improvements thereon designated as Lot 1 ("Parcel A") in Block 3623 on the Tax Map of The City of New York for Bronx County, New York (the "Tax Map"), and which is adjacent to Parcel B; WHEREAS, HDFC is the fee owner of the parcel of real estate and the improvements to Parcel A; WHEREAS, LBAC is the equitable and beneficial owner of Parcel A and Parcel B pursuant to that certain Declaration of Interest and Nominee Agreement dated as of October 27, 2011 and recorded on November 11, 2011 in CRFN 2011000401069 in the City Register of the City of New York. WHEREAS, Declarant entered into that certain Zoning Lot Declaration dated as of March 11, 2016 and recorded on May 12, 2016 in the City Register of the City of New York (Bronx County) at CRFN 2016000164320 (the “ZLDA"); Development Corporation ("HDC") and any provider of credit enhancement to HDC shall be deemed a third party beneficiary thereunder. NOW THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged,and the mutual covenants and agreements hereinafter set forth, Declarant, intended to be legally bound, hereby agrees: 1. Section 10.6 of the ZLDA is deleted and replaced with the following: "Nothing in this Declaration is intended or shall be construed to confer upon or to give to any person other than (i) the parties hereto (or their successors or permitted assigns) and (ii) the New York City Housing Development Corporation ("HDC") and any provider of credit enhancement to HDC, any right, remedy or claim under or by reason of this Declaration."
